evidence: host-probe.ts:7-14 already sets stdio to ignore/pipe/pipe, timeout to 10000 milliseconds and killSignal to SIGKILL. The suggested stdio setting is already present.

Executed the current built probeHostVersion under Node v26.7.0 using the existing disposable installer fixture. The fake host was a Bash launcher that spawned a non-exec Node grandchild with inherited stdout/stderr and a 15000-millisecond lifetime. The probe returned host-timeout after 10004 milliseconds while the grandchild was still alive; the fixture then killed that known descendant.

The inherited-pipe blocking assertion did not reproduce on the current runtime. Complete descendant reaping is a separate, unclaimed capability: the control explicitly observed a live grandchild after return. No assertion is made that arbitrary launchers leave no descendants or that all runtime builds implement identical cleanup.
